prices.title: Market prices
prices.subtitle: What farms on i12farm are asking this week, county by county. Each figure is the middle price (median) across farms, so one very high or low price does not move it.
prices.chartLabel: Weekly median price of {product} in {where} over the last 12 weeks

prices.wantedHint: From searches on i12farm in the last 30 days. If you farm one of these, buyers are waiting.
prices.wantedNone: Nothing stands out yet. This fills in as more buyers search.
prices.listYours: Put your farm on the map
prices.method: How this works: every week we take each farm's listed price at the end of the week (only things on sale, only published farms) and show the median, the lowest and the highest. These are asking prices, not prices paid, and pilot counties have few farms, so treat them as a guide. Searches are counted without names or phone numbers, and only words that at least 3 different phones searched are shown.
